review_candidates.title: Adversary Operations Chief
review_candidates.description: Job ID: 2616249 Location: Brandon, ENG, GB Date Posted: 2026-08-28 Category: Engineering and Sciences Subcategory: Specialty Engr Schedule: Full-Time Shift: Day Job Travel: Yes - 10% of the time Minimum Clearance Required: TS.SCI Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: None Potential for Remote Work: ORA_ON_SITE Description SAIC is seeking a Adversary Operations Chief to support the US Air Force Collaborative Operations for Battlespace Resilient Architecture (COBRA) program at Royal Air Force (RAF) Lakenheath (Brandon), United Kingdom. COBRA provides for the implementation, integration, development, and delivery of training and technology solutions to support the US Air Force, Department of Defense, and mission partner multi-domain operations (MDO) within the Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) strategy. Overview: The role of this position is to be the exercise control integrator between the 48 Fighter Wing’s daily flight operations and the 19th Electronic Warfare Squadron’s (19 EWS) Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) capabilities. The successful candidate is knowledgeable in 4th & 5th Generation fighter tactics and adversary weapons systems. They will be capable of leading the observation, assessment, and debrief of fighter maneuvers to analyze countermeasure effectiveness. Additionally, they will be responsible for synchronizing the EW and LVC support with 48 FW flight operations. The Adversary Operations Chief will: Function as the 48th FW’s dedicated adversary strategist (“Red Mission Commander”) for daily training, execution, and debrief. Direct real time scenario pacing and flow to ensure tactical problems remain realistic, adaptive, and aligned with identified desired learning objectives (DLOs). Program, operate, and integrate simulation models and associated emitter systems in coordination with on and off-station participants. Lead the employment of 19 EWS threat emitter systems to mimic a coherent “thinking” adversary to create realistic and dynamic threat training for aircrew during daily operations. Lead coordination between the 48 FW and 19 EWS to optimize training by synchronizing threat data replication with daily flight operations. Provide assessment and feedback on pilot responses to emitter threat systems. Incorporate high-level adversary threat and emitter systems TTPs and doctrine into scenarios and training events. Prepare, coordinate, and present USAF, Joint Force, and Allied air warfare briefings, support academic development and instruction, and lead air warfare discussions with a wide range of audiences as requested by the US Government. Design relevant scenarios informed by knowledge of US, Joint Force, Allied, and adversary real-world systems, capabilities, and tactics for integration into UAWC-sponsored and supported training and exercise events, with supporting presentations, briefings, and other exercise products. Develop exercise documents including Master Scenario Event List (MSEL), Air Operations Directives (AOD), Air Tasking Orders (ATO), Airspace Control Plans (ACP), Airspace Control Orders (ACO), Area Air Defense Plans (AADP), Special Instructions (SPINs), and mission execution products. Facilitate the Joint Event Life Cycle (JELC) of various exercises with warfighters by participating in exercise scenario development, mission planning, mass briefs, mission briefs, execution, debriefs, analysis, and after-action reports. Participate in formal/informal training events as required/directed to maintain tactical/technical skills. Contract position will support any additional related duties as required. Qualifications Required Experience/Qualifications Fighter Pilot (or rated equivalent) with a minimum of 8-years 4th or 5th Generation fighter aircraft experience. (Joint experience preferred). Relevant instructor / evaluator hours. Expert knowledge of USAF and Joint Force doctrine, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). Expert knowledge of adversary SAM TTPs Experience with the Joint Air Operations Planning (JAOP) or the Joint Operations Planning Process for Air (JOPPA) at the AOC, Component, COCOM, or Joint Staff level. Must have a U.S. Top Secret/SCI clearance and/or SAP Bachelor’s and eighteen (18) years or more experience or relevant years of experience in lieu of degree. US Citizen and active TS/SCI clearance Desired Experience/Qualifications: USAF C2 Warrior Advanced Course graduate USAF Weapons School graduate (or equivalent) USMC Weapons Instructor Course graduate Knowledge of NATO doctrine and tactics, techniques, and procedures Familiarity with the following systems: Next Generation Threat System (NGTS), Modern Air Combat Environment (MACE), Air Warfare Simulation (AWSIM), and Battlespace Command and Control Center (BC3).

review_candidates.title: Actuarial Analyst
review_candidates.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a motivated and analytical Actuarial Analyst to join our actuarial team. This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate, an early-career professional, or someone with a quantitative background who is interested in building a career in financial services and insurance. Actuarial work combines data analysis, financial modelling, risk assessment, and business problem solving to help an insurance company design and price products, understand its financial performance, and meet its commitments to customers. The role will provide hands-on exposure to actuarial work, with structured coaching and development from experienced actuarial professionals. Prior actuarial experience is not required. Position Responsibilities: Support regular actuarial valuation and financial reporting activities, including data preparation, model runs, result checking, reconciliations, and preparation of reporting materials. Assist with product pricing and product-related analysis, including preparing data and assumptions, running pricing models, checking outputs, and documenting results. Collect, validate, and analyze actuarial and business data; investigate unusual results or data issues and escalate findings as appropriate. Maintain and update actuarial models, spreadsheets, databases, process documentation, and working files under the guidance of senior team members. Support experience studies, assumption reviews, forecasts, financial planning, and other recurring or ad hoc actuarial analyses. Prepare clear summaries, reports, and presentation materials to communicate analysis and key observations to actuarial colleagues and other stakeholders. Work collaboratively with colleagues in Actuarial, Finance, Product, Risk, IT, and other functions to obtain inputs, resolve issues, and deliver work accurately and on time. Look for opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of actuarial processes through better use of Excel, VBA, AI tools, or other relevant technology, while following applicable controls and governance requirements. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or another relevant quantitative or business discipline. New graduates and candidates from accounting, finance, banking, audit, risk, data analytics, or other relevant financial-services backgrounds are welcome to apply. Prior actuarial experience is not required for the Actuarial Analyst level; relevant experience may be considered for appointment at the Senior Actuarial Analyst level. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to analyze information logically, question results, and identify practical solutions. Strong numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and commitment to producing accurate, well-documented work. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word; knowledge of VBA, AI tools, or other data and automation tools is preferred. Preferred Qualifications: Good written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and willingness to learn from feedback. Genuine interest in developing a long-term actuarial career within the insurance industry, including openness to pursuing professional actuarial qualifications with company support. When you join our team: We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want. We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words. As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
